rewrite.explanation: Each node keeps prev as well as next, so traversal runs in both directions and a node you already hold can be removed in O(1) - a singly linked list has to walk from the head to find the predecessor first. The cost is one extra pointer per node and two links to keep consistent on every insertion and removal, which is where doubly linked list bugs come from.
